description: Setting values shown with the setting shortcode and referenced by $setting in the Part specs (CONTRACT 5.3, 12.4): withholding costs tau, caps and exact grade counts, error weights, cutoffs, interval levels, seeds (league 20261030; replay r uses 20261030 + r), the teaching prior SD, KRW lambda, budgets, draw counts and the envelope failure chance.

settings.cap2.note: at most 2 grades (also the number of fixed tiers)

settings.cap3.note: at most 3 grades (also the number of fixed tiers)

settings.cap4.note: at most 4 grades (also the number of fixed tiers)

settings.cap5.note: at most 5 grades (also the number of fixed tiers)

settings.w.equal2.note: equal error weights on two criteria

settings.w60.note: theory book ch. 14/16 four-unit law weights (3/5, 2/5)

settings.w100.note: all error weight on the first criterion

settings.w0.note: all error weight on the second criterion

settings.seed.league.note: SR-06 default league seed (the frozen draw data/precomputed/league-30.json)

settings.prior15.note: teaching prior SD of the simulated league

settings.lambda33.note: lambda of the common KRW grade (tau = .25)

settings.mean30.note: posterior mean of unit A in the L-07 prediction

settings.mean10.note: posterior mean of unit B in the L-07 prediction

settings.sd20.note: posterior SD of units A and B in the L-07 prediction

settings.target90.note: the direction probability the L-07 open task aims for

settings.l02.truth50.note: true value of the unit in the L-02 prediction and presets

settings.l02.se20.note: SE of the L-02 prediction and preset se20 (the league's small units)

settings.l02.se10.note: SE of L-02 preset se10 (the league's medium units)

settings.l02.se05.note: SE of L-02 preset se05 (the league's large units)

settings.l02.draws20.note: the number of draws in the L-02 prediction and presets

settings.l02.draws200.note: the most estimates the L-02 widget holds

settings.prior05.note: L-04 preset: a narrow teaching prior

settings.prior60.note: the largest prior SD on the L-04 slider (a query above it is clamped here)

settings.se10.note: L-04 Equal SEs: every unit gets this SE (the estimates stay those of the frozen draw)

settings.l06.pi90.note: L-06: the direction probability that splits the overlapping league pairs (and a choice of the prediction)

settings.l06.pi99.note: L-06: a choice of the prediction and the open task's bound

settings.corr00.note: L-07 correlation box: the slider's default, independent posteriors

settings.corr95.note: L-07 correlation box: the slider's end (|corr| stops at .95)

settings.tb09.state.note: theory book ch. 9: the probability of each of the three listed states of law Q1 and of law Q2

settings.mix.w20.note: L-07 mixture box: weight of A's upper bump (the slider's default)

settings.mix.w80.note: L-07 mixture box: weight of A's lower bump when the upper one has .20

settings.mix.w50.note: L-07 mixture box: equal bump weights

settings.mix.lo.note: L-07 mixture box: center of A's lower bump

settings.mix.hi.note: L-07 mixture box: center of A's upper bump

settings.mix.sd10.note: L-07 mixture box: SD of each bump of A and of B's normal posterior

settings.mix.meanB.note: L-07 mixture box: posterior mean of unit B

settings.choice100.note: L-10 prediction: fewer than 100 wrong directions

settings.x02.tol005.note: X-02 typed answers on the probability scale: a value within .005 of the answer counts, so the answer rounded to two decimals passes

settings.x02.tol05.note: X-02 typed answers given to two decimals above 1 (an average count): the answer rounded to one decimal passes

settings.x02.tol1.note: X-02 typed expected counts above 10 given to one decimal: the displayed value rounded either way to a whole number passes

settings.pi85.note: G-01: the direction probability of A above B in the prediction and the deck preset

settings.pi80.note: G-01: the direction probability of the boundary preset at tau .20 (pi_AB = 1 - tau)

settings.pi50.note: G-01: the direction probability of the preset where all three actions are equally good (with tau .50)

settings.g04.omega80.note: G-04 deck preset: the posterior mean of firm 2 in KRW Example 1

settings.g04.omega50.note: G-04 preset krw-outside: the posterior mean of firm 2

settings.g04.omega81.note: G-04: one slider step to the right of the deck preset

settings.g04.threshold80.note: 1 - tau at tau = .20: an isolated pair is stated when its direction probability is above it (KRW's threshold .8)

settings.lambda01.note: S-02: the first positive lambda of KRW's grid (lambda = 0 lies outside postrank's tau range)

settings.lambda05.note: S-02: a choice of the grid question (the first lambda with more than one grade is .08)

settings.lambda08.note: S-02: the first lambda of KRW's race grid with more than one grade (krw.grid.race.firstmulti.lambda)

settings.lambda50.note: S-02: a choice of the grid question (the first lambda with more than one grade is .08)

settings.x02.tol002.note: X-02 typed probabilities where a common mistake lies close to the answer (Question on the L-07 preset wide-b: the gap divided by B's SD alone gives .631 against the answer .624): a value within .002 counts, so the displayed three-decimal answer passes and the mistake, even with its normal quantile rounded to two decimals, does not

settings.x02.tol0005.note: X-02 typed shares where a common mistake lies very close to the answer (Part 2 question on the G-05 preset optimum-draws: E/M = .0238 against the answer E/N = .0255): a value within .0005 counts, so the displayed answer and its three-decimal rounding .026 pass and E/M, even rounded to .024, does not

settings.pi70.note: X-02 Part 2 feedback on the G-03 preset tau30-nocap: the cut-off 1 - tau = .70 that a pair's direction probability must exceed for the pair, on its own, to be stated at tau = .30

settings.tau02.note: the smallest tau on the slider of The price of silence (G-03); the first two edge slopes of H(m) lie below it

settings.tau18.note: G-03 open task: the slider point below the change point at e_AB

settings.tau19.note: G-03 open task: the smallest slider point at which the best report without a cap states A above B

settings.r01.tol015.note: R-01 typed share: a value within .015 of the share stated by three tiers of 10 (20/29 = .690) counts, so .70 passes and two thirds (.667) does not

settings.r02.estA.note: R-02 two-unit example (theory book, ch. 2): estimate of unit A

settings.r02.estB.note: R-02 two-unit example: estimate of unit B

settings.r02.seA.note: R-02 two-unit example: SE of unit A

settings.r02.seB.note: R-02 two-unit example: SE of unit B

settings.r02.seB15.note: R-02 What to try: unit B's SE lowered until B is flagged too
